_about: The count for Peralta's Outcome Outline report (416) on lan.curriqunet.com, trial 45030224450 (S703): 12 pages, one a subject, Laney 4, Merritt 4, Berkeley City 2, Alameda 2. lan.curriqunet.com is an outcomes-only host (every page prints an Originator line, d-lan-outcomes-only-host-s703), so the trial filed parsed rows only and each count is read by eye off its excerpt log, apart from the parser. Keyed by code and printed college (recall_key). Every page's printed college is the one whose proposal type its index row carries, 12 of 12. The parser files 11 of 12 right: SLOs 12 of 12, objectives 11 of 12 (ARTH C1100). The shape trial 45026998155's five counts (ART 001 at the four colleges, ART 024 at Berkeley City) stay in tests/course_outcomes_read_test.py as fixtures.
